tools.name: search
tools.description: Find interface specifications for forms, tables, onboarding, and dashboards, or public facts about Jan Arvin Mito's projects and current Dupe contract. Returns document IDs and source URLs; use fetch for complete content.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Read an exact document ID returned by search, such as spec:form or project:dupe. Returns the full document, canonical source URL, and revision metadata. Does not fetch arbitrary URLs or files.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "validate_design_spec" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.
